title: ShellIntegrateResult
description: Result of the shell.integrate JSON-RPC method: the in-band bootstrap plan the renderer executes at a trusted prompt — the wrapper line typed at the prompt, the payload streamed through the raw-mode window, and the delimiter line that ends (or cancels) the stream (spec §4.4, nocx-ynsx).

wrapper.description: The single line typed at the prompt: captures the exact prior termios with `stty -g`, enters raw -echo mode, emits the READY OSC only after raw mode is on, stages the payload through sed until the terminator line, and restores with `stty "$saved"` on every path.

payload.description: The integration payload: a POSIX-sh dispatcher plus the bash/zsh/posix hook scripts framed by section markers, ending with the completion marker line. Streamed only after READY; never sourced without the completion marker.

terminator.description: The delimiter line that ends the payload stream. The renderer appends it (with a trailing newline) after the payload, or sends it alone to cancel an in-flight integration.
